name: Technicolor Antichrist Box
summary: Technicolor Antichrist Box is a single-level PK3 for Doom II requiring the GZDoom source port that came out in May 2020. It was designed by Shannon O'Neill (Major Arlene) and uses the music track "Kontayjen" by John Weekley (PRIMEVAL). The par time defined in ZMAPINFO is 20:00. The mod was selected as one of the runners-up at the Cacowards 2020 ceremony.
